title: Secret Cities S2
desc: Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke explore Beirut, a diverse city shaped by its Phoenician and Roman past, French influence, and 15-year civil war. They discover how art and architecture confront the city's troubled history while embracing its future. Their journey includes the National Museum's ancient artefacts, a war memorial, innovative architecture, street art, Armenian heritage, and Beirut's vibrant nightlife, revealing a city shaped by multiple cultures, identities, and memories.
